content:
The phrase "what the world whispers" contrasts with "apartheid declares with snarling guns."  
The world "whispers" suggests that other nations criticize apartheid quietly or in a muted way, while South Africa’s racist system enforces its will violently and openly.  
Among the options, (C) fits best — the world condemns South Africa’s discrimination, but does so in a "whisper" (quietly, perhaps without strong action), unlike the loud, violent "declaration" of apartheid.  

Final answer: (C)
